description: Implementation of CachedGrainLocator class for managing grain location caching within the Orleans runtime. It handles lookup, registration, unregistration of grains, cluster membership change listening, and cache management.

classes.name: CachedGrainLocator
classes.description: Handles caching and lookup of grain addresses, registration, unregistration, and responds to cluster membership changes within Orleans runtime.

classes.name: CachedGrainLocator.ITestAccessor
classes.description: Interface for testing and accessing internal state such as LastMembershipVersion.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Performs cache lookup and fallback to directory lookup for a given grain ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a grain address in the directory and cache.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a grain address from local cache and directory.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes to lifecycle events to start/stop listening to cluster membership updates.

methods.name: ListenToClusterChange
methods.description: Listens for cluster membership changes and cleans up dead silos.
